title: Example City water billing portal outage
disclaimer: Made for entertainment using AI. Not endorsed by any utility, agency, news outlet, company, or anyone else named. This incident is a made-up sample.
size_basis: One utility's online billing portal. The water supply itself was not affected.
who_is_affected: Customers of Example City Water who pay bills online. Water service was not interrupted, and nothing needs to be done beyond paying once the portal is back.

known.text: The online billing portal went offline at 8:40 AM ET on Jan 12.
It was back online at 5:20 PM ET the same day.
The utility says a failed software update caused it.

not_known.text: Whether anyone outside the utility has reviewed its account.
Whether customer payment data was exposed.

charts.title: Problem reports per hour
charts.alt: Reports rose from 3 at 8 AM to a peak of 212 at 11 AM, then fell steadily to 4 by 6 PM.
charts.caption: Counts as published by Example Daily News.

charts.title: Payments taken, by channel
charts.alt: Online payments fell from about 4,200 on a usual day to 310, while phone and in-person payments more than doubled.
charts.caption: Figures as reported by Example Wire.

images.caption: The portal was offline for 8 hours 40 minutes.
